intro.title: Test useFetch
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll learn how to test a custom Vue composable called `useFetch` that handles API data fetching. You'll build a test suite to verify that the composable correctly manages loading states, error handling, and data retrieval from an external API. The core concept involves using Vue's testing utilities to simulate API responses and assert expected behaviors. You'll work with Jest, Vue Test Utils, and mocking techniques to isolate your tests from real network calls. By the end, you'll understand how to write reliable tests for reactive composables in Vue applications.
intro.usecase: Testing custom hooks like useFetch is essential for building reliable data-driven applications. In real products, this pattern appears when developers need to ensure that API integrations in dashboards, admin panels, or e-commerce product listings work correctly under various conditions. For example, testing useFetch helps verify that a user's profile page loads their data without errors, or that a search filter fetches and displays updated results properly. This practice ensures that your application handles loading states, errors, and data updates consistently, leading to a more stable user experience.
